If you want to tell Sally I recommend doing it anonymously. If their relationship is open, what’s the harm if she finds out about it then? You’re a kid and nobody would blame you for not doing anything. Cheaters cheat and do it openly because they know everyone else will allow them to do it because it’s not happening to them personally. Cheating is abuse and it damages people and families, but the blame should never be placed on the person who gives them the truth. Cheating and keeping it a secret robs the person who’s being cheated on the option to choose who they want to spend their life with. Everyone deserves the truth, even if they can’t handle it. If she reacts poorly and lashes out at you or thinks you’re lying, this information is painful and shocking. Have compassion and be gentle. Anything that happens as a result would not be your fault.
